scope: Current robot hardware evidence; not a verified wiring diagram or runtime authorization

platform.value: Freenove hexapod chassis with modified Furby-like head

reported_leg_faults.symptom: Does not fully extend with other legs on stock power-up
reported_leg_faults.evidence: evidence/2026-10-16/rear-right-leg-reported-extension-fault.jpg; operator reports subsequently repositioning leg by hand
reported_leg_faults.status: operator-reported symptom; asymmetric photographed pose observed; root cause not diagnosed
reported_leg_faults.agent_movement_test: not performed; robot USB connection absent
reported_leg_faults.precaution: Motor power off during inspection; do not force powered joints or run repeated startup/gait tests against possible binding/stall

motion_controller.board_identity_evidence: FREENOVE silkscreen in earlier photos; V3.1 marking now visible adjacent to POWER control in evidence/2026-10-16/power-button-v3.1-closeup.jpg

mcu.evidence: AVRDUDE 7.1 wiring/STK500v2 signature read on 2026-10-15; 262144-byte flash and 4096-byte EEPROM read and independently verified; flash includes ATmega2560 identifier
mcu.method_limit: Bootloader-reported identity, not direct ISP/physical chip-marking verification

pin_map.status: vendor reference only; not electrically qualified on installed board
pin_map.servo_signal_headers: Arduino D22 through D39; leg/joint orientation and calibration not qualified
pin_map.warning: Two versus three supply groups differ across official schematics. Do not select installed pin mapping from MCU identity alone; the diagnostic image never writes these pins.

usb.identity_limit: Both the handheld remote and robot controller enumerate with this generic bridge; VID/PID cannot distinguish them

serial_echo.identity_limit: Confirms stock-compatible echo behavior, not board model, installed firmware version, or safety readiness

legacy_handheld_remote.evidence: Original photos preserved in evidence/2026-10-15/remote-*.jpg; indexed by evidence/2026-10-15/manifest.json
legacy_handheld_remote.identity_limit: V4.1 belongs to the photographed remote assembly; do not assign it to the robot controller

control_reference.power_switch: Blue square actuator on white latching pushbutton housing, labelled POWER on the controller; distinct from the small RESET button
control_reference.installed_visibility: Observed directly in evidence/2026-10-16/power-button-v3.1-closeup.jpg after operator slid clear plate aside; electrical OFF state is not inferred from button appearance
control_reference.separate_battery_disconnect: No separate battery-disconnect connector has been identified on the modified robot; do not imply one exists or identify the unknown white connector as battery power
control_reference.handling_isolation: USB unplugged and both removable cells removed isolates the stock controller from those sources before handling; this is not a tested emergency-cutoff procedure

safety_qualification.supported_bench_setup: operator reports feet raised; current front camera confirms elevated chassis on an oval white case, but all-foot clearance and support restraint are not visible

last_test_conditions.actuator_power: disconnected, reported by operator before USB tests
last_test_conditions.controller_connection: operator reports USB moved from handheld remote to robot controller
last_test_conditions.commands: echo plus no-write bootloader signature, flash/EEPROM readback and verification; no motion or firmware writes
last_test_conditions.warning: These are historical test conditions, not proof of current physical isolation; reconfirm before opening serial

latest_bench_inspection.operator_report: USB unplugged, batteries installed, robot raised off desk
latest_bench_inspection.usb_observation: lsusb finds Kinect v2 but no CH340 robot bridge; no serial access attempted
latest_bench_inspection.camera_observation: Fresh 1920x1080 Kinect optical frame shows front of robot, elevated chassis supported on an oval white case
visibility_limits: Not all six feet and their full movement clearance are visible

latest_bench_inspection.next_view: Side/underside view of all feet, chassis support and accessible battery cutoff before powered checks

second_camera.status: observed; captured current 1280x720 side image through /dev/video0
second_camera.visibility: Side of robot on broad padded case; controller switch and battery contacts remain obscured. Full leg sweep and restraint still not qualified.
